x: The spotlight however was on the superlative display of Wil Wesch who thrashed a much fancied Dave Watson to take the individual honours. As usual Wil started fast and moved easily until the last lap when he took the rest of the field to the cleaners with a sustained burst of high speed walking.
At 7 miles he was with the leader Dave Watson from Southampton but then disaster struck and Bob was pulled and with him Belgrave's chances for team honours.
At Salisbury for the Hampshire Championship Len Duquemin walked a tremendous race but had to give way to the local boy Dave Watson. John Moullin, working back to peak form finished third.
